mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 3.5% and PAYEMS increases by > 200k over 3 months, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns are positively affected over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances productivity and thus positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year non-recessionary rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in such periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST, signaling strengthened housing demand, positively affects consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of months with positive HOUST growth, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds its 6-month moving average, indicating rising inflation expectations, and FEDFUNDS is below 3%, investors anticipate monetary policy adjustments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in UNRATE below 4%, signaling a tight labor market, enhances wage growth prospects, positively influencing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only in non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year non-recessionary rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in such periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when RSAFS increases by > $50B over 1 month and GDPC1 shows quarterly growth, signaling robust demand, S&P 500 forward returns are positively affected over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS 1mo change > $50B and GDPC1 quarterly growth > 0
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.
